description: One echo turn: command, fileRead, search, a delegation with a child turn, planSteps, a suppressed tool, the bb echo_stamp tool answered by the server, the receipt extension item, the mood state, the echoed message, usage.
note: Recorded on a dev bb (bb plugin install <path>, shout=true, BB_ECHO_PROVIDER_GREETING unset) with BB_PROVIDER_BRIDGE_RECORD_DIR in the daemon env, then scripts/provider-recordings/package-cells.mjs. The echo bridge has no provider child, so the provider lanes are empty.
